_pattern: THE PATTERN, FOR THE NEXT STUDY THAT PRODUCES A REGENERATABLE ARTIFACT
(read draft/audit/artifact_freshness_infra_2026-08-16.md for the full
history; this is the two-sentence version to keep in your head):
1. Your study writes a committed JSON artifact from a Python function
that takes no required arguments (a `run()` / `compute()` /
`build_artifact()` / `grade()` — whatever name reads naturally) and
is called with no args by your module's own `main()`.
2. Add ONE entry to the `entries` list below: {id, description,
owner_module, artifact_path, regenerate_command}. That is the whole
registration. Do NOT write a bespoke
`test_X_matches_regeneration` pytest function, and do NOT add
`@pytest.mark.repo_parity` anywhere — `draft/tools/
check_artifact_freshness.py` now covers every entry here
automatically, informationally, every time it is run (including
from scripts/verify-relay-session.sh).
3. If your artifact only needs to be compared against a SUBSET of the
committed file (e.g. you're grading a reproduction against another
study's already-committed artifact, not writing your own), add
`compare_keys`: a list of dotted paths into both documents; the
checker extracts and diffs only those subtrees. See the
`props_season_projection_v6_reproduction` entry for a worked example.
WHY THIS EXISTS: `pytest draft/tests` used to carry one bespoke
`test_X_matches_regeneration` function per artifact-producing study,
each hand-marked `@pytest.mark.repo_parity` and hand-added to the pinned
node list in test_gate_selection.py, because a committed artifact
legitimately drifts from a fresh regeneration every time the board or
its inputs move (that is not a bug — see conftest.py's docstring). This
happened, individually, for own_model_v2 through v6, model_accuracy_
backtest, source_weight_prior, playoff_sos, draft_replay_2025,
replay_all_seats, and props_season_projection — ten separate manual
interventions for the exact same underlying pattern, diagnosed across
five separate passes in draft/audit/rebuild_refusal_diagnosis_2026-08-16.md.
Cory's ruling: fix it permanently. This registry plus
check_artifact_freshness.py is that fix — freshness is now checked by ONE
generic, informational tool instead of N bespoke, hand-maintained pytest
gate items. See draft/tests/conftest.py for the code-correctness-vs-
artifact-freshness distinction this replaces the STALE half of.

entries.description: props_season_projection's read-only reproduction of own_model_v6's construction (_v6_predictions + _grade_models), checked against own_model_v6's OWN committed artifact rather than props_season_projection's own (which is still pending real historical-props data).

import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, 'draft/tools')
sys.path.insert(0, 'draft/backtest')
sys.path.insert(0, 'draft')
import props_season_projection as P
from model_accuracy_backtest import positions_record
from own_model_v2 import _grade_models, board_ages
positions = positions_record()
ages = board_ages()
v6_pred = P._v6_predictions(positions, ages)
got = _grade_models({'own_v6': v6_pred}, P.GRADED_SEASON, positions)
print(json.dumps({'arm_2025': {'models': {'own_v6': {'cells': got['models']['own_v6']['cells']}}}}))

_not_yet_migrated: These repo_parity-marked tests are a DIFFERENT species (ratchet-vs-
today's-market, coverage-vs-live-board, or a repo-workflow-file parse
check needing a library the gate venv lacks) and do not fit this
registry's committed-artifact-vs-regeneration shape. They stay as
hand-marked pytest tests, pinned in test_gate_selection.py's
REPO_PARITY_NODES, per the classification in
draft/audit/rebuild_refusal_diagnosis_2026-08-16.md §6/§7:
- draft/tests/test_adp_sd_measured.py (4 params) — grades keepers.py's
shipped dispersion constant against TODAY'S fetched FFC market, not
against a committed artifact.
- draft/tests/test_playoff_sos.py::test_every_board_skill_player_is_ranked_or_honestly_absent
— coverage/partition of the LIVE board's player set, not an
artifact-equals-regeneration diff.
- draft/tests/test_weekly_own_projection.py::test_own_weekly_workflow_yamls_parse_and_carry_dry_run
— parses repo workflow YAML files; marked because the gate venv
carries no pyyaml, not because of board staleness.
- draft/tests/test_freeze_not_stale.py::test_the_freeze_carries_every_field_it_declares
(2026-08-17) — the pre-draft freeze MUST NEVER be regenerated to diff
against: a freeze regenerated today is precisely the thing it exists to
prevent, and freeze_pre_draft refuses to overwrite (no --force) for that
reason. So this registry's artifact-vs-regeneration shape cannot cover
it. The check is instead artifact-vs-its-OWN-DECLARATION: every field in
freeze_pre_draft.PLAYER_FIELDS must appear on at least one frozen row.
Red today and correctly so — the 08-14 freeze predates fourteen declared
fields, all of which the live board carries; the fix is a dated draft-day
re-freeze, not a code change.
Also explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this pass: anything fetch_weekly_props.py-
adjacent (the weekly-props study was still in flight 2026-08-16 per
ROUTES.md) — none of its tests currently carry repo_parity, so there is
nothing to migrate yet, but a future pass should check again once that
study lands before assuming it is clear.
